title: Edit Untouched Text In An Already Reviewed Paragraph
task: Using docxedit only, apply a first guarded tracked replacement to a plain paragraph with --track-changes require.
In a second patch against the reviewed output, replace a disjoint untouched span in the same paragraph, again under require.
Attempt a third patch overlapping the existing revision markup and record how it fails.
Verify the final output with docxedit read in markup view, docxedit changes, and docxedit validate.
successCriteria: Produces reviewed output where two disjoint spans carry separate revision pairs.
Shows the overlapping edit failing safely with E6002.
Does not inspect raw OOXML package parts or quote private document text.
observerQuestions: Did the second tracked edit on untouched text succeed without touching the first revision?
Did revision IDs continue and reports stay coherent across patches?
Was the overlap refusal legible and actionable?
